overall: Violation found: vague 'Financial Department' notice, improper telephone deliberation before the July 6 auditors meeting, post-adjournment discussion, and inaccurate minutes. No violation for the Water Department gathering; generalized claim declined. Revised minutes and training certification ordered.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the June 28, 2012 meeting notice listed a topic, 'Financial Department,' too vaguely to show the anticipated discussion and action.
allegations.key_passage: The topic, "Financial Department" on the June 28, 2012 meeting notice was vague and did not offer the public an understanding of the anticipated topic to be discussed at that particular meeting

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a quorum deliberated outside a posted meeting, including around July 6, 2012, when members prepared for an auditors' meeting.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Committee improperly deliberated by telephone prior to the anticipated meeting with the auditors on July 6, 2012.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a quorum deliberated at the Water Department gathering on July 6, 2012, which was not a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: while we do not find evidence that a quorum of the Committee deliberated outside of a properly posted meeting when it met at the Water Department on July 6, 2012

allegations.summary: Members continued discussing the termination after the July 10, 2012 meeting adjourned, captured on the meeting recording.
allegations.key_passage: the Committee should not have engaged in this discussion because the meeting had adjourned.

allegations.summary: Reviewing the complaint, the AG found the June 25, June 28, and July 10, 2012 open-session minutes inaccurate and lacking sufficient detail (not raised by complainant).
allegations.key_passage: we find that the minutes from the June 25, 2012, June 28, 2012, and July 10, 2012 meetings are inaccurate and lacked sufficient detail.

allegations.summary: Complainant's generalized allegation that fellow members deliberate outside meetings was declined as a request for a broad audit.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review this allegation because our office will not conduct broad audits of public bodies based on generalized allegations.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that similar future conduct may be considered evidence of intent to violate it.
Draft and approve revised minutes of the June 25, June 28, and July 10, 2012 meetings within 30 days of receiving the letter.
Review the Open Meeting Law Guide and the determination, and certify in writing to the AG within 30 days that members have done so.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar conduct may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
